pointing: Continuous geocentric nadir: radial optical axis toward Earth's centre, intersected with the WGS84 ellipsoid.
scene_location_description: Western Toulouse area; nominal nadir trace at the closest daylight passage to the adopted city-centre coordinates during June and July 2025.

provenance.source: Space-Track GP_HISTORY, with SGP4 propagation through Skyfield 1.54

parameter_status: The user selected nadir pointing, Toulouse, June-July 2025, a 5 km square image and 50 m reconstructed sampling. The date, adjusted centre, along/cross-track grid orientation and geocentric nadir convention are assistant-selected simulation refinements.
qualification: Nominal orbit-based simulation geometry. Displayed digits describe reproducible calculations; actual orbit, attitude and geolocation accuracy require separate evidence. The 50 m value specifies reconstructed sampling. Traversal times describe along-track ground motion; complete spectral-image acquisition duration depends on each optical architecture, exposures, reconstruction and edge coverage.
